What happens when society begins to collapse at the very moment people are becoming less equipped to deal with it? Russell Brand is joined by Gabe Lyons to discuss the simultaneous breakdown of human wellbeing and the institutions we once trusted. From declining health and critical thinking to loneliness, addiction and widespread despair, Gabe argues that we're facing a crisis far deeper than politics or economics. Russell reflects on his own struggles with despair, his son's health challenges and his journey towards Christianity, as they explore whether faith, repentance and rebuilding genuine communities offer a way out of a society increasingly consumed by isolation and spiritual darkness.
